description: Use this after search_listings when the user wants two to six Homejourney listings compared side by side. Pass their listing_ids, and optionally the user criteria: budget, bedrooms, bathrooms, preferred districts or MRT stations, the longest acceptable walk to the MRT, and must-have features. Returns the listings ranked against those criteria, each with its score, the reasons it fits, its tradeoffs and any missing data, plus price, size, nearest MRT and nearby schools for each. Never returns owner or agent contact details. To show the result as a card, pass it to render_shortlist.

max_mrt_walk_minutes.description: Longest acceptable walk to the nearest MRT or LRT station, in minutes.

mrt_stations.description: Preferred MRT or LRT stations, matched against each listing's nearest station.

host.description: The AI app making this call, such as chatgpt or claude. It records where the request came from; it is not the listing owner or agent.

name: compare_listings

listings.description: Each listing also carries its rank, score, reasonCodes and tradeoffs.

bookingUrl.description: Where the user asks for a viewing.

floorplans.description: Details only: published floor plan image URLs.

imageLabels.description: One per image, in order: the tag to show with an owner's edited photo, or null for an unedited one.

listedAt.description: When the listing was first shown publicly.

nearbyPlaces.description: Details only: the places the listing page shows near the block. mrtStations (code, name, walkMinutes), primarySchoolsWithin1Km and primarySchools1To2Km (the Primary 1 registration bands), secondarySchools, and supermarkets (name, place, walkMinutes), each with distanceKm. Distances are straight-line from the block and walks are estimates; for Primary 1 registration, the user checks the exact distance on OneMap SchoolQuery.

price.description: SGD; monthly rent for a rental.

seller.description: Details only, for an owner listing: whether the owner verified with Singpass, and their weekly viewing hours (Singapore time, weekday 0 is Sunday; empty when none are open).

title: Compare Homejourney listings
